parsed.why: Low-risk tier; statewide gender-identity discrimination ban operating, open markers, city sanctuary shielding travellers, no facility ban. Gaps: no state hate-crime cover; parent's passport regime still applies.

Statewide birth-sex facility and shelter bans, indecent-exposure statute, criminalised gender-expression performance upheld, documents closed since 1977, no nondiscrimination, police indifference and violence above background with panic defence.

Do Not Travel tier: birth-sex facility ban covering airports with criminal penalties plus private bounty lawsuits, and invalidation notices for mismatched licences — universal, self-executing exposure with no remedy yet.

Moderate tier: no adult facility or care ban, documents changeable, municipal protections covering 46% of population, no violence record. Weakened by statewide nondiscrimination gap, hate-crime gap, and appointed-board restrictions.

Escalating tier: facility ban extended to public colleges and universities, freeze-frame prison treatment policy, birth-sex definition, no hate-crime statute — local exposures slightly exceeding the national baseline.
